name: Reply to Any Post
subtitle: Paste any post, get the context and a strong reply.
summary: Reads any public post live (author, engagement, and the top replies by likes so you don't repeat them), then drafts a reply that adds something the thread doesn't already have.
howToAsk: Draft a reply to this post.
get: post context, what the top replies already said, one strong reply draft.
launchPrompt: Help me write a strong reply to this post (check what the top replies already said first): [paste link]
